overlaps.definition_divergence: The quoted phrase is from author manuscript, METHODS, 'Estimating idiosyncrasy index'; the complete verbatim definition is preserved in the existing dossier audit, §1b/§1d. GraphFLA's global_idiosyncratic_index side is under review. The current implementation uses an analytic sqrt(2)*std(f) baseline and min_pairs=3; the paper's author notebook uses a matched-size resampled control and states no minimum background filter (NOT STATED IN PAPER.). Here all 828 mutations have at least 3 retained backgrounds, so min_pairs excludes none. The GraphFLA builder also removes isolated viable genotypes before the metric reads fitness values, shrinking the denominator pool from the 28,530 rows supplied to 24,627 retained rows; see notes for code locators and the decomposition.

input.preprocessing: Fit rescaled by /0.5; use rows with rescaled fitness >1.0 for the random-pair pool and GraphFLA input; mutation effects are log(f_mut/f_bg), excluding pairs that touch the exact rescaled floor 1.0. Verbatim author-code locators are in notes.

overlaps.graphfla_call: DNALandscape().build_from_data(X, f, epsilon=0, verbose=False); A.global_idiosyncratic_index(ls, n_jobs=1, seed=0, min_pairs=3), with X=viable Seq strings and f=log(Fit/0.5).
overlaps.reason: These local results are computed outputs, NOT STATED IN PAPER. The independent implementation produced 0.6121000731 (SE 0.0045646619), which reproduces the printed target at its precision. GraphFLA returned 0.5873601678. Substituting GraphFLA's analytic baseline on the same full viable input gives 0.5942481263, a -0.0178519468 shift; min_pairs=3 excludes 0 mutations and contributes 0. The additional -0.0068879585 comes from the GraphFLA builder dropping isolated viable genotypes from the baseline pool. Total GraphFLA-minus-paper gap is -0.0247399053. Computed values and code locators are in notes.

verdict_reason: The printed tRNA target was reproduced independently from the authors' data and notebook procedure. GraphFLA does not reproduce it under its current implementation; the mismatch is quantified and attributable here to the analytic baseline and builder removal of isolated genotypes, while min_pairs=3 has no effect on this input.
